itemList.description: Survey and demarcation of Plantation boundary lines after clearing the rank growth to a width of 2 m. in the areas with sparse under growth

Ripping along the contours at an appropriate interval to a depth of 75 cm, with a ripper attached to the bulldozer; the ripper having side flange attachment, which will rip open a trench to a width of 45 cm (on running meter basis). 500 Trenches or 2150 Rmtr.

Mechanical excavation of cattle proof trench of size top width 1.5 M. bottom 1.0 M. & vertical depth 1.0 M.with an initial lead up to 2 M. & depositing the excavated soil uniformly over the inner side of the CPT & forming conical mound of height 1.0 M. (including compacting the mound in hard soil or Barbed wire fencing as provided in the SSR item No. 86)
Procurement of seeds of suitable local species for sowing on the mounds of the CPT during next rains.

Gully Checks / Boulder bunds / Check dam / SMC Works
(Preferably gully checks if any have to be in the drains)
Raising of 4"x6" seedlings for trasplanting into 8"x12" PBs
Cost of HDPE bags including 18% GST
Procurement of 0.9225 cum. Farm Yard Manure / Compost, 0.9225 cum. of Sand and 1.845 cum of Redearth. (4.20 cum. required for 8"x12" minus 0.51 cum of transplanted 4"x6" bag).
Mixing the ingredients, filling the polythene bags and arranging in rows after scraping the earth.
Transplanting of 4" x 6" size bagged seedlings into 8" x 12" size bags.
Watering to the Polythene bagged seedlings twice a day from 01-12-2026 to 31-03-2027 (121 days).
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Purchase of nursery equipments, Payment of nursery watchers etc.
